body: Pakistan International Airlines has received its first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, the first Dreamliner operated by a Pakistani airline. The aircraft arrived at Islamabad International Airport from London Heathrow on November 1, 2026, operating as flight PK786.

The aircraft was not bought new: it is wet-leased from Norse Atlantic Airways under an ACMI agreement covering two Boeing 787-9s that was signed in October. Under the arrangement, Norse Atlantic provides the aircraft and crew and keeps responsibility for maintenance and insurance, while PIA operates the passenger services. Pakistani media reports described the jet as about eight years old, having entered commercial service in May 2018, with a reported capacity of 358 passengers and in-flight entertainment.

The main purpose is to add capacity between Pakistan and the United Kingdom. PIA returned to London on March 29, 2026, after a six-year absence that followed the lifting of restrictions on Pakistani airlines flying to the UK, and has planned additional services from Islamabad and Lahore to London Heathrow and Manchester. The first Dreamliner is scheduled to replace Boeing 777 equipment on selected London services, with Manchester operations also planned, and a second Dreamliner is expected to add further capacity once it joins the operation.
en.summary: Pakistan International Airlines has taken delivery of its first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, wet-leased from Norse Atlantic Airways, to add capacity on Pakistan-United Kingdom routes.
en.title: Pakistan International Airlines receives first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner

body: 巴基斯坦國際航空迎來首架波音787-9夢幻客機，也是巴基斯坦航空公司首次引進夢幻客機。該機於2026年11月1日以PK786班機從倫敦希斯洛飛抵伊斯蘭馬巴德國際機場。
這架飛機並非新購機，而是向北歐大西洋航空濕租，雙方10月簽署的ACMI協議涵蓋兩架787-9；依協議，北歐大西洋航空提供飛機與組員並負責維修與保險，巴基斯坦國際航空負責客運營運。巴基斯坦媒體報導，該機機齡約8年，2018年5月投入商業營運，據報載客量為358人並配有機上娛樂系統。
引進夢幻客機的主要目的是增加巴基斯坦與英國之間的運能。巴基斯坦國際航空於2026年3月29日重返倫敦，此前因英國解除對巴基斯坦航空公司的飛航限制而結束長達6年的缺席，並計畫增開伊斯蘭馬巴德與拉合爾往返倫敦希斯洛與曼徹斯特的航班。首架夢幻客機預定取代部分倫敦航線的波音777，第二架加入後可望進一步增加運能，曼徹斯特航線也在規劃之中。
zh.summary: 巴基斯坦國際航空迎來首架向北歐大西洋航空濕租的波音787-9夢幻客機，將用於增加巴基斯坦與英國之間的運能。
zh.title: 巴基斯坦國際航空迎來首架波音787-9夢幻客機
